per_rep_success_rate.interpretation: Of every 10 cued grasps in a session, the deployed pipeline produces a sustained (≥250 ms) correct motor command for 9.8.

false_activation_per_min_rest.interpretation: During patient rest periods, the deployed pipeline incorrectly issues a non-rest motor command 1.91 times per minute of rest on average; in a 5-min therapy session with ~70% rest, this is ~6.7 spurious activations.

time_to_correct_command_ms.interpretation: From the ground-truth cue/transition onset, the system takes ~149 ms (mean) to issue its first sustained correct motor command. This is the deployment latency from intent → action that a patient experiences.
